body.x: Enercamp will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its portable high-capacity P-ESS ENERCAMP E1.

Enercamp's jump starter products are notonly able to jump discharged vehicles in 10 seconds, but also can be used asauxiliary batteries while being carried. It is already popular in North America(Amazon) as well as in Korea.
Enercamp has continued to develop high-capacity power stations that can be carried around for energy use without space constraints by consumers. It will showacase the finished product at CES 2020.

E1, the first runner in the ENERCAMP E series, is a high-capacity power station that can provide one-day’s worth of power during outdoor activities. In addition, with its exclusive application, it provides remote control and messenger up to 1.2 miles with the built-in wireless communication module in areas where there is no Internet and telephone. This enables SOS feature in case of emergency or disasters.
Unlike other competitors, by the exclusive application in addition to the product itself, it can be used smarter and more convenient by controlling and using the energy anytime and anywhere.

Also, in countries and regions where power failures are frequent, the portable high-capacity power station E1 can be used for emergency power. It can be charged by its PD charger and also by cigar jack (12V) and even the eco-friendly solar panels when power source is unavailable. As such, ENERCAMP E1 products pursue eco-friendly and renewable smart energy life.

An official said, "Enercamp is headquartered in Korea and is in progress to become a global IT company with global development and production lines in US (Silicon Valley) and China (Shenzhen). We will also launch the US Kickstarter campaign based on our two successful experiences in Korea's largest crowdfunding platform (115% and 1035%), and will expand to the global market, starting with the North American market.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
